decision_scope: Option 2: Narrow the study scope to descriptive and exploratory feasibility
decision_text: Formally close Research 3 under the descriptive and exploratory feasibility scope. Retain the frozen hybrid candidate (reports/hybrid_score_candidate_20260925_v1/candidate.json) as an exploratory candidate.

structural_ocr_support_limitation.finding: Frozen upstream thresholding (text_score >= 0.5) in RapidOCR mathematically truncates input support to [0.5, 1.0], preventing three-bin [0, 0.5) calibration for entrance classes under Coverage v2.

wave_s_clean_view_saturation.finding: Grounding DINO and RapidOCR achieve 100% precision on chairs and signage across 261 views, with geometric localization error strictly isolated to doorway portal void penetration (20 correct, 6 incorrect).
wave_s_clean_view_saturation.doorway_error_mechanism: Geometric localization error isolated to doorway portal void penetration where depth rays traverse the open portal void rather than striking jamb boundaries.

resolved_blockers.B03: Resolved under descriptive and exploratory feasibility deliverable: structural OCR truncation and clean-view saturation demonstrated; no further unviable sampling waves scheduled.
resolved_blockers.B09: Resolved under descriptive and exploratory feasibility deliverable: final closure formally recorded, audit reports packaged, and Research 3 terminated without invalid calibration claims.
